purpose: Make every assistant follow the same solution governance while enforcing fixed provider boundaries: Codex/OpenAI and Claude Code/Anthropic.

dialog_first.description: Project creation and implementation should be driven by the local chat/dialog request in VS Code, Claude Code or Codex. VS Code tasks are optional shortcuts, never the required path.
dialog_first.content_collection_rule: All user-provided goals, constraints, files, decisions, approvals, and missing business context for corporate solution creation must be requested and confirmed through these assistant chat channels.
dialog_first.non_primary_channel_rule: Non-primary channels may execute shortcuts, validation, scaffolding, or tool calls only after the assistant chat flow has collected or confirmed the required user content.
dialog_first.if_missing: Ask only for the missing business context before implementation unless the user explicitly asks for discovery.

missing_information_protocol.rule: If any minimum dialog field or universe-specific decision is missing, ask the user in the chat before creating or implementing.
missing_information_protocol.communication_style: clear, objective, short questions in Portuguese when the user is speaking Portuguese
allowed_inference: requested_universe may be inferred from the user's wording, but must be confirmed when ambiguous
technical archetype may be inferred by BusinessSolutionAnalyzer after minimum dialog fields are present
missing_information_protocol.assistant_response_when_missing: Return the missing fields and ask direct questions instead of implementing.

mandatory_flow: classify request as project creation, project implementation, data treatment, ML/DL/time-series, RAG, chatbot, agent, or hybrid
check minimum dialog fields and ask the user for missing information before implementation
read shared dialog memory before asking the user to repeat context
append a short task summary to shared dialog memory for chat-requested work
run or consult the business solution analyzer before choosing architecture
write or update config/business_solution_analysis.json and docs/briefings/business_solution_analysis.md for projects
for ML or hybrid projects, apply config/ml_foundations_policy.json before model selection, training, evaluation, or release
select the technology layer from config/ai_framework_selection.json before creating frameworks, agents, pipelines, templates, MCP servers, RAG or MLOps components
for RAG universes, apply config/rag_scalability_policy.json and ask the user every pending scale decision before choosing a production vector database
before any fine-tuning, apply config/fine_tuning_policy.json: measured prompt + RAG baseline, curated dataset, human approval
apply config/harness_engineering_policy.json to every agent: context map, tool boundary, loop budgets, verification, observability and feedback
select universe and solution stack from the analysis
use Codex/OpenAI or Claude Code/Anthropic directly for generation; block sensitive content instead of routing it to a cloud provider
work with a single assistant per task; workflow steps are owned by roles in config/roles.json
follow the autonomy matrix in config/harness_engineering_policy.json for destructive or external actions
create or update tests and evals according to the selected universe
validate with deterministic tests before reporting completion

ml: Use MLOps architecture with data contract, baseline, feature pipeline, model card, local registry artifacts, monitoring, drift checks, tests, and evals.
Map experience, task, performance measure, hypothesis space, assumptions, estimation objective, validation strategy, regularization, and feature transformations before choosing algorithms.
Use math/statistics metrics appropriate to the business problem before optimizing models.
ia: Use AI engineering architecture with RAG, MCP/tool boundaries, agents when action is required, guardrails, token cost controls, local model routing, tests, and evals.
Prefer RAG for trusted knowledge and agents for multi-step execution.
chatbolt: Use chatbot architecture for conversation, RAG for trusted answers, handoff policy, session memory, guardrails, safety evals, and chatbot-specific tests.
Do not treat chatbot, RAG, and agent as the same pattern.
hybrid: Combine MLOps and AI engineering only when the business problem needs prediction plus knowledge or action.
Share data contracts, governance, tests, evals, observability, and cost policy across both sides.

codex: Read AGENTS.md and this policy before planning project creation or implementation.
Use scripts/analyze_business_solution.py or BusinessSolutionAnalyzer for architecture selection.
Collect or confirm all user-requested business content through Codex chat before relying on tasks, scripts, or tools.
Use the same Synapse project artifacts as VS Code Chat and Claude Code: shared memory, analyzer, technology catalog, governance docs, tests, and evals.
Implement the smallest safe change that satisfies the analysis and tests.
Use OpenAI/Codex directly for analysis and code editing.
claude_code: Read CLAUDE.md and this policy before planning.
Use the analysis as the architecture decision record for coding, review, and agent coordination.
Collect or confirm all user-requested business content through Claude Code chat/terminal before relying on tasks, scripts, or tools.
Use the same Synapse project artifacts as VS Code Chat and Codex: shared memory, analyzer, technology catalog, governance docs, tests, and evals.
Respect prompt caching and do not resend large catalogs unless required.
Use Anthropic/Claude directly for analysis and code editing.
vscode_chat: The user can request project creation or implementation directly in chat.
The assistant should ask for missing business context, run/consult analyzer, then create/update project artifacts.
Collect or confirm all user-requested business content through VS Code Chat before relying on tasks, scripts, or tools.
Use the same Synapse project artifacts as Codex and Claude Code: shared memory, analyzer, technology catalog, governance docs, tests, and evals.
